scenarios.command: three competing explanations for the Q3 fixture widget recall are filed at http://127.0.0.1:46799/recall-brief. for each explanation, read its dossier and the independent lab report it links, then tell me which explanation the lab evidence supports, with the measurement it rests on, and say what ruled out each of the other two

args.headline: Weigh three recall explanations against their lab reports
args.objective: Read the recall brief at 127.0.0.1:46799/recall-brief, follow each of the three explanations to its dossier and linked independent lab report, then identify which explanation the lab evidence supports (with the key measurement) and what ruled out the other two.

args.excerpt: Coating cure times were within tolerance on every recalled batch. This theory is NOT supported.
args.observation: Lab report for the ceramic coating cure theory: cure times were within tolerance on every recalled batch — theory NOT supported.

args.excerpt: Bearing seats on every recalled batch were machined 0.4 mm undersize. This theory is SUPPORTED.
args.observation: Lab report for the bearing seat machining theory: bearing seats on every recalled batch were machined 0.4 mm undersize — theory SUPPORTED.

args.excerpt: Packaging matched spec on every recalled batch. This theory is NOT supported.
args.observation: Lab report for the packaging compression theory: packaging matched spec on every recalled batch — theory NOT supported.

args.subject: Bearing seat machining is the supported recall explanation
args.detail: Lab found bearing seats machined 0.4 mm undersize on every recalled batch; coating cure and packaging compression lab reports both found in-spec/no-support.

metrics.answerText:
## Q3 fixture widget recall — verdict

I read all three dossiers at the recall brief and their linked independent lab reports. **Exactly one is supported:**

### ✅ Supported: bearing seat machining
- **Measurement it rests on:** bearing seats on **every recalled batch were machined 0.4 mm undersize** ([lab report](http://127.0.0.2:35907/lab-bearing) — "This theory is SUPPORTED.")

### ❌ Ruled out: ceramic coating cure
- Cure times were **within tolerance on every recalled batch** ([lab report](http://127.0.0.2:35907/lab-coating) — "This theory is NOT supported.")

### ❌ Ruled out: packaging compression
- Packaging **matched spec on every recalled batch** ([lab report](http://127.0.0.2:35907/lab-packaging) — "This theory is NOT supported.")

The dossiers themselves state no verdicts ([coating](http://127.0.0.1:46799/theory-coating), [bearing](http://127.0.0.1:46799/theory-bearing), [packaging](http://127.0.0.1:46799/theory-packaging)) — all conclusions come from the independent lab.
